title: Remove the legacy cloud console code paths (console_lambda and kbs cloud token)
description: The legacy cloud console stacks were deleted under kbs-14a848 and infra/cloud was removed in PR #532, but Rust still carries the code that served them. Readers of the 14 legacy-cloud KANBUS_* variables documented in docs/ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLES.md: rust/src/bin/console_lambda.rs (KANBUS_API_STAGE, KANBUS_AUTH_MODE, KANBUS_COGNITO_DOMAIN_URL, KANBUS_COGNITO_CLIENT_ID, KANBUS_COGNITO_REDIRECT_URI, KANBUS_COGNITO_LOGOUT_URI, KANBUS_COGNITO_ISSUER, KANBUS_IDENTITY_POOL_ID, KANBUS_TENANT_ACCOUNT_CLAIM_KEY, KANBUS_TENANT_PROJECT_CLAIM_KEY, KANBUS_IOT_DATA_ENDPOINT, KANBUS_MQTT_CUSTOM_AUTHORIZER_NAME) and rust/src/cli.rs (KANBUS_CLOUD_API_BASE_URL, KANBUS_CLOUD_ID_TOKEN for the kbs cloud token commands). Confirm nothing in the current kanbus-api or @kanbus/cdk path uses them, remove the binary, commands, their specs and docs, and update the inventory. Spec-first: remove the scenarios together with the code.
